items.heading: Sort By Subject and Age,
items.text: Sort by subject and age, then by date. Use the filter table. Remove every door your Class 12 subjects or date of birth already closes. Keep the rest.

items.heading: Run One Small Test
items.text: Run one small test on each. Design: finish one drawing or observation set each week. Statistics or research: work one real problem set and one short data project. Uniform or sea: book the medical. Give each test as long as it honestly takes.

items.heading: Write the Decision Down
items.text: Write the decision down. One page: what you chose, what it costs, what you gave up and the date you will review it. Show it to your family.
